data.change_summary: Audited the pending molt/mineral amendments against current HEAD and found the substantive runtime, species-data, and regression updates already present, including the named temperature/NH3 knobs, the low-GH mineral-floor coverage, and the tightened soft-vs-hard/very-low-GH assertions. The only code change needed in this pass was to fix `ShrimpPreset::validate` so `temp_condition_low_divisor_c` and `temp_condition_high_divisor_c` are treated as positive-valued shrimp parameters instead of unit-interval fields; that unblocked shipped `neocaridina_davidi` preset validation, scenario materialization, and the downstream data/scenario test suites under the new named divisor wiring.
outstanding_risks: Workspace still contains unrelated dirty-tree entries that I left untouched: `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7`, `.ralph-burning/`, and untracked `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_validation_suite.rs`.
`cargo fmt --all --check` is not clean because the unrelated untracked `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_validation_suite.rs` is not rustfmt-formatted; I did not modify that file in this pass.

steps.description: Inspected the pending molt/mineral amendments against the current branch to determine which runtime/species/test changes were already present and which gaps still reproduced locally.
Fixed the remaining preset-validation drift by removing the new temperature divisor fields from the shrimp preset unit-interval validation bucket so they validate as positive-valued named parameters.
Revalidated the molt/mineral, save/load, validation, data, scenario, and full `tank_core` surfaces after the preset fix to confirm the pending amendments hold end to end.
